name: io.giftgenius/gift-genius
title: Gift Genius
description: Gift ideas for a specific person, occasion and budget, with a link to see them and where to buy.

tools.name: find_gift_ideas
tools.description: Get 9 personalized gift ideas for a specific person, each with a reason it fits and within the budget, plus one giftgenius.io link that opens the same ideas with photos and where to buy them. Pass every detail you already know about the recipient; only relationship, occasion and budget are required. Call again with "exclude" for more ideas, and with "feedback" (what the user said about the earlier ones) for ideas that follow it.

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

recipient.description: The recipient in a few words when more specific than the relationship, e.g. "my girlfriend", "my niece", "my kid's teacher" (max 40 characters).

occasion_name.description: The occasion in a few words when none of the listed ones names it, e.g. "a housewarming", "Valentine's Day", "her retirement" (max 40 characters).

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

description.description: The user's own description of the person, in their words, when they gave one, e.g. "my dad turns 62, golfs every Saturday and is always planning a house project". Read together with the other fields (max 600 characters).

exclude.description: Names of ideas already shown, to get 9 different ones. The most recent 45 are used.

feedback.description: What the user said about the ideas already shown, in their words, e.g. "he manages big house projects, he doesn't do them himself". The next ideas follow it. Used together with "exclude" (max 240 characters).

store.description: Limits every idea to one store: "amazon", or "etsy" for handmade, personalized and vintage things from small makers. Left out, the ideas are a mix of both.

tools.name: find_hobby_gifts
tools.description: Get up to 9 gift ideas for someone's hobby, pitched at their skill level (just curious, getting into it, obsessed), within the budget and skipping what they already own, plus a giftgenius.io link that opens the same ideas with photos and where to buy them. Also returns what someone at that level probably owns already. Pass what you know they own; the more specific, the better.

hobby.description: The hobby, as specific as you know it, e.g. "home espresso", "pickleball", "watercolor painting".

level.description: How into it they are: "curious" (just trying it), "getting-into-it" (has the basics, practicing regularly) or "obsessed" (deep into it, owns good gear).

owns.description: What they already own for this hobby, brands and models if known (max 300 characters). Ideas skip these.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25, 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus. Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

relationship.description: Who the gift is for, if known. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

tools.name: check_gift_idea
tools.description: Get an honest second opinion on a gift the user already has in mind: a verdict (great, good, risky or rethink), reasons it works, specific risks, 3 upgrades within the budget (an add-on, a better version or a swap) and a presentation tip, plus a giftgenius.io link that opens the verdict with where to buy each one. Pass the gift and every detail you already know about the recipient; gift, relationship, occasion and budget are required.

gift.description: The gift the user is considering, in a few words, e.g. "an espresso machine" or "a Minecraft hoodie" (3-120 characters).

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

tools.name: make_gift_shortlist
tools.description: Turn the 2 to 5 ideas the user liked into one giftgenius.io page: only those picks, each with the reason it fits, a photo and a price where there is one, and a link to buy it. Use it after find_gift_ideas, find_hobby_gifts or check_gift_idea, once the user has said which ideas they like. Pass the list_url of each result the picks came from and the picks' names as returned. The page is easy to decide from and to send to someone else who has a say.

list_urls.description: The list_url of each earlier result the picks came from (find_gift_ideas, find_hobby_gifts or check_gift_idea), up to 4. The first one says who the shortlist is for.

picks.description: Names of the 2 to 5 ideas the user liked, as the tools returned them, the favorite first.

tools.name: find_gifts_for_list
tools.description: Get gift ideas for several people in one call: 5 personalized ideas for each of 2 to 10 people, each idea with a reason it fits and within the budget, plus a giftgenius.io link per person that opens that person's ideas (these and more) with photos and where to buy them. For a holiday list, a family or a team. Pass one entry per person with every detail you already know; only the relationship is required for each. People are identified by their position in the list, not by name.

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

budget.description: Price per gift for everyone on the list: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

budget.description: Price per gift for this person, when it differs from the budget for the list.

people.description: The 2 to 10 people to find gifts for, one entry each, without their names. Results come back in the same order.

tools.name: make_wish_list
tools.description: Turn the things the user wants for themself into one giftgenius.io wish list page: each thing named clearly with a link to find it, grouped by price. The people the page is sent to can mark "I'm getting this", so nobody buys the same thing twice. Pass 1 to 12 things in the user's words, each with any color, size, model or price range they gave. Entries that are not things to buy are left off and returned in "skipped". The list has no name on it and no account.

item.description: One thing the user wants, in a few words, e.g. "label maker" or "wool running socks".

details.description: Color, size, model or what it is for, if the user said (max 200 characters).

budget.description: The price range the user wants it in, if they gave one: under-25, 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus.

items.description: The 1 to 12 things the user wants for themself, one entry each.

occasion.description: What the wish list is for. Omit when there is no occasion.

tools.name: start_secret_santa
tools.description: Get a giftgenius.io link that opens the Secret Santa organizer with the spending limit, swap date, kind of group, group name and a note already filled in. On the site the organizer either shares one join link or types everyone in, names are drawn so nobody draws themself, and each person gets a private link that reveals who they are buying for, with room for gift hints. The tool saves nothing and draws nothing: the group is made in the person's browser when they press the button, and who drew whom is never returned here. No accounts and no email addresses are needed. Every field is optional.

way.description: How people get into the draw: "join" (the default) gives the organizer one link to post in the group chat and everyone adds themself; "names" has the organizer type everyone in on the site.

kind.description: The kind of group: family, friends or work.

limit.description: Spending limit per gift in whole US dollars (5 to 500).

date.description: The day gifts are swapped, as YYYY-MM-DD.

group_name.description: What the group is called, e.g. "Cousins' Christmas" (max 40 characters).

note.description: A short note from the organizer to everyone, e.g. "Bring it wrapped, no gag gifts" (max 120 characters).

tools.name: list_gift_guides
tools.description: List Gift Genius's hand-picked gift guides: holiday and relationship guides (e.g. Christmas gifts for mom, stocking stuffers, white elephant, under $25) and age guides for every age from 1 to 90, plus 95 and 100. Use get_gift_guide with a slug to read one. Age guide slugs follow "gift-ideas-for-N-year-olds".

category.description: Only holiday/relationship guides, or only age guides. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_gift_guide
tools.description: Read one Gift Genius guide by slug (from list_gift_guides, or "gift-ideas-for-N-year-olds" for ages 1 to 90, 95 and 100): its gift ideas by section, each with why it fits, plus the giftgenius.io page for the guide, where every idea has a link to buy it.
